title: A Stretchable Nanowire UV-Vis-NIR Photodetector with High Performance

nodes.label: Wearable optoelectronics need a photodetector that covers UV to NIR and keeps working under large stretching
A PbS QD-P3HT hybrid nanowire written as a free-standing arch should sense UV to NIR and tolerate stretching
P3HT as the semiconducting polymer matrix of the wire
Blend PbS quantum dots into the P3HT as NIR sensitisers and charge acceptors
Free-standing nanowire arch of r ~250 nm and l ~50 um bridging Au and Al pads, in a 3x3 array on PDMS
Meniscus-guided direct writing, so a single wire can be placed on chosen electrodes without lithography
QD loading 0-60 wt%, QD size 4.4-9.1 nm, nine wavelengths 365-940 nm, stretching 0-100% and 100 cycles

attrs.variables: QD loading, QD size, wavelength, stretching

nodes.label: Pyrolyse organometallic precursors to PbS QDs and blend them with P3HT in toluene
Pull a micropipette meniscus of the blend into a free-standing wire that dries in flight, then bond its other end to the second electrode

attrs.mechanism: meniscus stretching with rapid solvent evaporation

nodes.label: PbS QDs are dispersed through the body of the written P3HT nanowire
The written wire stands as a free arch spanning the electrode gap rather than lying on the substrate
The ON/OFF ratio rises with QD loading and falls with QD size, peaking at 60 wt% of 4.4 nm QDs

attrs.direction: increase with loading, decrease with QD size

nodes.label: The hybrid wire responds from 365 to 940 nm, whereas the NIR response is absent without QDs
QDs absorb into the NIR and transfer photogenerated holes to P3HT, a transfer that weakens as the QD grows and the band offset becomes unfavourable
Switching is fast: rise and fall within ~0.16 s in the UV-vis and ~0.5 s in the NIR for a single wire
The 3x3 array holds its ON/OFF ratio and response time through stretching to 100% and 100 stretch cycles
The arch geometry takes up the external strain by unbending, so the wire material itself is barely strained
Directly written PbS QD-P3HT nanowire arches give a stretchable UV-vis-NIR photodetector array with high and stable ON/OFF ratios
The UV-vis ON/OFF ratios beat earlier UV-to-NIR nanowire photodetectors by about two orders of magnitude
The NIR response is far weaker than the visible one, so the broadband claim is uneven across the band
The array's ON/OFF ratios and response times sit about an order of magnitude off the single-wire values at the same wavelengths, and the text does not reconcile them
The SEM inset shows a single written wire arching from the Au pad across the gap to the Al pad, as the scheme intends

nodes.label: PbS quantum dots act as NIR sensitisers in hybrid polymer photodetectors
Photoinduced charge transfer between P3HT and PbS quantum dots quenches the QD photoluminescence
A larger PbS dot gives an unfavourable band offset that restricts hole transfer to P3HT
An arched free-standing wire accommodates substrate strain by geometric relaxation

notes: Device paper with two structure claims doing different work: the QD dispersion (a10) carries the photoresponse branch and the arch shape (a11) carries the stretchability branch; they meet at the array performance a16. The sweep is read twice, over loading (c6) and over QD size (c7), and the size trend is what the PL-quenching mechanism a14 explains. Numbers come from the panels: plateau ON/OFF ~300/~600/~15 at 365/625/850 nm from F2a-c (each panel has its own axis maximum), rise/fall times from the TR and TF labels printed on the expanded traces, array values ~27/~50/~4 and 0.3-0.7 s from F4e/F4f. Two audits. a20: the NIR plateau is about 40 times below the visible one, so the UV-vis-NIR claim is uneven. a21 with the text-silent OBS c13: the array in Figure 4 reads about an order of magnitude below the single wire of Figure 2 at the same wavelengths (625 nm ~50 vs ~600; rise ~0.4 s vs 0.16 s), a gap the differing light intensities do not cover and the text does not mention. Panel-section defects: the OCR cue lines are systematically wrong for this paper, typing every plotted panel as a 'micrograph' and reading the wavelength labels as scale bars ('scale bar 365nm', 'scale bar 625nm', 'scale bar 850nm', 'scale bar 4.4nm'); F4f's OCR read the letter as (s) against the detector's f; and F4 is tiered B4_text_only although its six panels are all matched. The EDS inset of F1b and the NIR inset of F3c are not offered as panels, so c3 carries panel_ids []. Lost: the Schottky I-V of Figure S3, the detectivity and Table 1 benchmark, the XRD rock-salt identification in Figure S2, and the P3HT-only control of Figure S4.

changes: c3: panel_ids set to F1b and the image_note corrected. The EDS inset is inside the F1b crop - the packet's OCR labels for F1b are the inset's own axis labels (Pb, S, Cu, 4, 8) - so the node should cite it, as c8 already does for the absorption inset in F3c.

panel_checks.note: F2b opened: the 625 nm plateau sits at ~600 on an axis that tops out above 1200, over six on-off cycles, and the right-hand expansion prints TR <= 0.16 and TF <= 0.12. Both the plateau values of c4 and the time labels of c5 are on the panels cited.

F3b plots ON/OFF ratio against QD size 4.4-9.1 nm on a log ordinate for all nine wavelengths; every series falls monotonically, steepest between 4.4 and 5.5 nm and flattening above 7 nm, exactly as the node and its note say.

F4e holds the array ON/OFF ratios flat at ~27 (365 nm), ~50 (625 nm) and ~4 (850 nm) from 0 to 100% stretching on a log axis with wide error bars. This panel is also what makes the c13 audit real: ~50 here against ~600 in F2b at the same wavelength.

review.audit_summary: Three audits, all load-bearing: a20 (the NIR plateau is ~40x below the visible one, so the broadband claim is uneven across the band, which qualifies a13) and a21 with the text_silent OBS c13 (the array's ON/OFF ratios and rise times are about an order of magnitude off the single-wire values at the same wavelengths and the text never reconciles them). c13 is a cross-figure reading and the judge reproduced it panel by panel; the quoted intensity difference does not cover an order of magnitude, so the node is fairly stated. c10's track_feature_across_series is correct under the r04 narrowing: it follows one identified arch through loading frames. Packet defects: the 'cues' lines invent scale bars for xy panels ('scale bar 365nm' on F2a, F3a, F3b, F4c-f), and F4f's OCR letter (s) disagrees with the detector's f.
